subject: Re: Contrack kickoff - entity repository as the assistant memory layer
body:
Anders,

Resourcing, as promised.

Compute is modest: ~600 GPU-hours on titan-a100 best-effort for the training sweeps, no Vulcan reservation needed. The bottleneck is data, not silicon. Real multi-party transcripts with clean plural-mention annotations basically do not exist in our corpus, and buying them is a 12-week procurement.

So we are building a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch. Csilla Nassar owns it at 50% from May 4 through the end of the window, with Linnea Yamada at 25% on the templating and validation side. Scope: scenario templates, entity/attribute samplers, a coreference-chain generator with controllable ambiguity, and a validation pass that rejects degenerate dialogues. Target 80k synthetic sessions by May 29.

Fumiko stays at 60% on the model itself. Ines has confirmed the titan quota, nothing to escalate there.

Bruno
